tree.text:
Batch size (slices at once)
batch_​size

tree.toolTip: How many slices go to the graphics card together; lower it if the card runs out of memory.

tree.text:
How 2D becomes 3D
method

tree.toolTip: The way the three views are joined into 3D cells. Only Direct is offered.

tree.text:
CPU cores
n_​cpu

tree.toolTip: How many processor cores the 3D build uses.

collapsible.title: Smooth before joining
collapsible.engineStyle: color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.styleSheet: text-align: left; border: none; outline: none;
color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Smooth the cell maps
pre_​smooth_​probs

tree.toolTip: Blur each view's cell-probability map before the views are joined, so cells do not step from slice to slice.

tree.text:
Smooth the flows
pre_​smooth_​flows

tree.toolTip: Blur each view's flows before the views are joined.

tree.text:
Blur across slices
pre_​smooth_​sigma_​perp

tree.toolTip: How far the blur reaches across the slices of each view; higher removes stripes between slices.

tree.text:
Blur within a slice
pre_​smooth_​sigma_​inplane

tree.toolTip: How far the blur reaches within a slice; keep it low to keep detail.

tree.text:
Ignore flows below
flow_​mask_​threshold

tree.toolTip: Flows where the cell probability is below this are set to zero. Used only with Smooth the flows.

tree.text:
Weigh flows by cell probability
flow_​soft_​weighting

tree.toolTip: Scale the smoothed flows by how likely each voxel is inside a cell. Used only with Smooth the flows.

tree.text: The two fields above are used only with Smooth the flows.

collapsible.title: Follow the flows
collapsible.engineStyle: color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.styleSheet: text-align: left; border: none; outline: none;
color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Step fade
gradient_​decay

tree.toolTip: How fast each step shrinks as voxels follow the flows; higher suits long, thin cells.

tree.text:
Steps
n_​iter

tree.toolTip: How many steps each voxel takes along the flows.

tree.text:
Momentum
momenta

tree.toolTip: How much of the previous step each step keeps (0 to 1). Rarely changed.

tree.text:
Rescale the flows at each step
renorm_​gradient

tree.toolTip: Set the flows back to unit length at every step.

tree.text:
Use several cores
do_​mp

tree.toolTip: Cut the volume into pieces and follow the flows on several cores at once.

tree.text:
Piece depth
tile_​shape[0]

tree.toolTip: The depth of the pieces the volume is cut into for several cores. Used only with Use several cores.

tree.text:
Piece height
tile_​shape[1]

tree.toolTip: The height of those pieces. Used only with Use several cores.

tree.text:
Piece width
tile_​shape[2]

tree.toolTip: The width of those pieces. Used only with Use several cores.

tree.text:
Piece overlap
tile_​overlap_​ratio

tree.toolTip: How much neighbouring pieces overlap, as a fraction. Used only with Use several cores.

collapsible.title: Combine the probabilities
collapsible.engineStyle: color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.styleSheet: text-align: left; border: none; outline: none;
color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Neighbourhood size
ksize

tree.toolTip: How many neighbouring voxels are pooled when the three views' probabilities are joined into 3D.

tree.text:
Balance between views
alpha

tree.toolTip: A small count added before pooling so no single view dominates; higher evens the views out more.

tree.text:
Smooth the joined mask
smooth_​sigma

tree.toolTip: Blur the joined 3D cell mask before it is cut.

tree.text:
Threshold level
threshold_​level

tree.toolTip: Which automatic cut level decides whether a voxel is a cell; 0 is the lowest, and it must be below Number of levels minus 1.

tree.text:
Number of levels
threshold_​n_​levels

tree.toolTip: How many bands the automatic threshold splits the probabilities into; there is one fewer level to choose from.

tree.text:
Fixed cell threshold
prob_​thresh

tree.toolTip: Set the cell-or-not cut by hand, from 0 to 1. Auto uses the two levels above.

tree.text:
Lowest cell threshold
min_​prob_​thresh

tree.toolTip: The automatic cut never goes below this.

tree.text:
Round the threshold down to 0.1
apply_​one_​d_​p_​thresh

tree.toolTip: Round the automatic cut down to one decimal place.

collapsible.title: Clean the mask
collapsible.engineStyle: color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.styleSheet: text-align: left; border: none; outline: none;
color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Remove specks smaller than
remove_​small_​objects

tree.toolTip: Pieces of the 3D mask with fewer voxels than this are removed.

tree.text:
Fill holes
binary_​fill_​holes

tree.toolTip: Fill holes inside the 3D mask.

tree.text:
Close gaps
binary_​closing

tree.toolTip: Close small gaps in the mask; the number is the size of the tool in voxels.

tree.text:
Grow the mask
binary_​dilation

tree.toolTip: Grow the mask outwards by this many voxels.

tree.text:
Shrink the mask
extra_​erode

tree.toolTip: Shrink the mask by this many voxels after the steps above.

collapsible.title: Combine the flows

tree.styleSheet: text-align: left; border: none; outline: none;
color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Neighbourhood size
ksize

tree.toolTip: How many neighbouring voxels are pooled when the three views' flows are joined into 3D.

tree.text:
Balance between views
alpha

tree.toolTip: A small count added before pooling so no single view dominates.

tree.text:
Smooth the 2D flows first
smooth_​sigma

tree.toolTip: Blur each view's flows before they are joined.

tree.text:
Smooth the joined flows
post_​sigma

tree.toolTip: Blur the 3D flows after they are joined.

collapsible.title: Group into cells
collapsible.engineStyle: color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.styleSheet: text-align: left; border: none; outline: none;
color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Smallest cluster
min_​area

tree.toolTip: Clusters of fewer voxels than this are not made into cells.

tree.text:
Density cut
thresh_​factor

tree.toolTip: Where points count as crowded: the average density plus this many spreads.

tree.text:
Density blur
smooth_​sigma

tree.toolTip: How much the point density is blurred before clusters are found.

collapsible.title: Size limits
collapsible.engineStyle: color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

color: #777777; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Consolas', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;

tree.text:
Skip the size limits
skip_​postprocess

tree.toolTip: When ticked (the default), the final clean-up after the 3D build does not run, so the size limits below drop nothing. Untick it to apply them.

tree.text: Size limits are off while this is ticked.
Cells outside this size range are dropped by the final clean-up after the 3D build, which runs only while “Skip the size limits” is unticked.

Smallest cell
min_​size

tree.toolTip: Cells with fewer voxels than this are dropped.

tree.text:
Largest cell
max_​size

tree.toolTip: Cells with more voxels than this are dropped.

tree.text:
Largest vs typical
max_​size_​factor

tree.toolTip: With the tick below: a cell larger than the average size plus this many spreads is dropped.

tree.text:
Drop cells far from the typical size
do_​stats_​filter

tree.toolTip: Drop cells much larger than the typical cell, by the rule above.

collapsible.title: Smooth before joining

tree.text:
Smooth the cell maps
pre_​smooth_​probs

tree.toolTip: Blur each view's cell-probability map before the views are joined, so cells do not step from slice to slice.

tree.text:
Smooth the flows
pre_​smooth_​flows

tree.toolTip: Blur each view's flows before the views are joined.

tree.text:
Blur across slices
pre_​smooth_​sigma_​perp

tree.toolTip: How far the blur reaches across the slices of each view; higher removes stripes between slices.

tree.text:
Blur within a slice
pre_​smooth_​sigma_​inplane

tree.toolTip: How far the blur reaches within a slice; keep it low to keep detail.

tree.text:
Ignore flows below
flow_​mask_​threshold

tree.toolTip: Flows where the cell probability is below this are set to zero. Used only with Smooth the flows.

tree.text:
Weigh flows by cell probability
flow_​soft_​weighting

tree.toolTip: Scale the smoothed flows by how likely each voxel is inside a cell. Used only with Smooth the flows.

tree.text: The two fields above are used only with Smooth the flows.

tree.text:
Step fade
gradient_​decay

tree.toolTip: How fast each step shrinks as voxels follow the flows; higher suits long, thin cells.

tree.text:
Steps
n_​iter

tree.toolTip: How many steps each voxel takes along the flows.

tree.text:
Momentum
momenta

tree.toolTip: How much of the previous step each step keeps (0 to 1). Rarely changed.

tree.text:
Rescale the flows at each step
renorm_​gradient

tree.toolTip: Set the flows back to unit length at every step.

tree.text:
Use several cores
do_​mp

tree.toolTip: Cut the volume into pieces and follow the flows on several cores at once.

tree.text:
Piece depth
tile_​shape[0]

tree.text:
Piece height
tile_​shape[1]

tree.toolTip: The height of those pieces. Used only with Use several cores.

tree.text:
Piece width
tile_​shape[2]

tree.toolTip: The width of those pieces. Used only with Use several cores.

tree.text:
Piece overlap
tile_​overlap_​ratio

tree.toolTip: How much neighbouring pieces overlap, as a fraction. Used only with Use several cores.

tree.text:
Neighbourhood size
ksize

tree.toolTip: How many neighbouring voxels are pooled when the three views' probabilities are joined into 3D.

tree.text:
Balance between views
alpha

tree.toolTip: A small count added before pooling so no single view dominates; higher evens the views out more.

tree.text:
Smooth the joined mask
smooth_​sigma

tree.toolTip: Blur the joined 3D cell mask before it is cut.

tree.text:
Threshold level
threshold_​level

tree.toolTip: Which automatic cut level decides whether a voxel is a cell; 0 is the lowest, and it must be below Number of levels minus 1.

tree.text:
Number of levels
threshold_​n_​levels

tree.toolTip: How many bands the automatic threshold splits the probabilities into; there is one fewer level to choose from.

tree.text:
Fixed cell threshold
prob_​thresh

tree.toolTip: Set the cell-or-not cut by hand, from 0 to 1. Auto uses the two levels above.

tree.text:
Lowest cell threshold
min_​prob_​thresh

tree.toolTip: The automatic cut never goes below this.

tree.text:
Round the threshold down to 0.1
apply_​one_​d_​p_​thresh

tree.toolTip: Round the automatic cut down to one decimal place.

extra_​erode
